description: Search Meta Ad Library by keyword — active/inactive, media type, date range, platforms, cursor, and spend/impressions when Meta publishes them. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

ad_type.description: all (default) or political_and_issue_ads. Spend/impressions are typically only filled for political/issue ads.

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code (e.g. US, GB, DE). Default US.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous nextCursor. Pages through the current Meta HTML result batch.

end_date.description: Only ads with delivery start on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 200). Flat 2 credits per call.

media_type.description: Creative filter: ALL (default), IMAGE, VIDEO, MEME, IMAGE_AND_MEME, or NONE.

platforms.description: Comma-separated publisher platforms to keep: FACEBOOK, INSTAGRAM, MESSENGER, AUDIENCE_NETWORK, THREADS.

q.description: Keyword, brand, or advertiser to search Meta Ad Library (min 2 characters).

sort_by.description: Meta sort mode: total_impressions or relevancy_monthly_grouped.

start_date.description: Only ads with delivery start on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

status.description: Ad delivery status: ACTIVE (default), INACTIVE, or ALL. Use ACTIVE for "what are they running now?".

trim.description: When true, omit cards/images/videos typed arrays (media[] stays). Captapi payloads are already lean vs Meta nested snapshots.

name: facebook_ad_library_search
title: Facebook Ad Library Search
